akhfash:8-8.t: He said ﴿وَوَصَّيْنَا ٱلإِنْسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ حُسْناً﴾ on the basis of "and We enjoined him goodness"; a man may say: "وَصَّيْتُهُ خَيْراً" (I enjoined him good), i.e. with good.

akhfash:12-12.t: And He said ﴿وَلْنَحْمِلْ خَطَايَاكُمْ﴾ as a command, as though they commanded themselves.

akhfash:19-20.t: And He said ﴿كَيْفَ يُبْدِئُ ٱللَّهُ﴾ and He said ﴿كَيْفَ بَدَأَ ٱلْخَلْقَ﴾, because they are two dialect forms; you say "بَدَأَ الخَلْقَ" and "أَبْدَأَ" (He originated creation).

akhfash:22-22.t: And He said ﴿وَمَآ أَنتُمْ بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِي ٱلأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ﴾, i.e. you cannot escape Us by fleeing on earth or in heaven.

akhfash:33-33.t: And He said ﴿إِنَّا مُنَجُّوكَ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلاَّ ٱمْرَأَتَكَ﴾: because the first was in the meaning of tanwīn, since it (the rescue) had not yet occurred; for that reason the second (أهلك) is accusative.

celaleyn:36-36.t: ﴿وَ﴾ We sent ﴿إِلَى مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًا فَقَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ وَارْجُوا الْيَوْمَ الْآخِرَ﴾ fear it; it is the Day of Resurrection; ﴿وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial) that reinforces its governing word (ʿāmil); from ʿathiya, with kasra on the thāʾ: he worked corruption.

celaleyn:37-37.t: ﴿فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ﴾ the violent earthquake, ﴿فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ﴾ fallen on their knees, dead.

celaleyn:38-38.t: ﴿وَ﴾ We destroyed ﴿عَادًا وَثَمُودًا﴾ with and without nunation (ṣarf) [وَثَمُودَ], in the sense of the tribe and the clan; ﴿وَقَدْ تَبَيَّنَ لَكُمْ﴾ their destruction ﴿مِنْ مَسَاكِنِهِمْ﴾ at al-Ḥijr and in Yemen; ﴿وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ﴾ of unbelief and acts of disobedience, ﴿فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ﴾ the path of truth, ﴿وَكَانُوا مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ﴾ possessed of insight.

celaleyn:39-39.t: ﴿وَ﴾ We destroyed ﴿قَارُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَامَانَ وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ﴾ before that ﴿مُوسَى بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ﴾ the manifest proofs, ﴿فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا سَابِقِينَ﴾ escaping Our punishment.

celaleyn:40-40.t: ﴿فَكُلًّا﴾ of those mentioned ﴿أَخَذْنَا بِذَنْبِهِ فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِ حَاصِبًا﴾ a violent wind carrying pebbles, like the people of Lot; ﴿وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ أَخَذَتْهُ الصَّيْحَةُ﴾ like Thamūd; ﴿وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ خَسَفْنَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ﴾ like Qārūn; ﴿وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ أَغْرَقْنَا﴾ like the people of Noah, and Pharaoh and his people; ﴿وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ﴾ by punishing them without sin, ﴿وَلَكِنْ كَانُوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ﴾ by committing sin.

celaleyn:41-41.t: ﴿مَثَلُ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ﴾ i.e. idols from which they hope for benefit, ﴿كَمَثَلِ الْعَنْكَبُوتِ اتَّخَذَتْ بَيْتًا﴾ for herself, in which she takes shelter; ﴿وَإِنَّ أَوْهَنَ﴾ the weakest ﴿الْبُيُوتِ لَبَيْتُ الْعَنْكَبُوتِ﴾ it keeps neither heat nor cold away from her; likewise the idols do not benefit those who worship them; ﴿لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ that, they would not have worshipped them.

celaleyn:42-42.t: ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا﴾ in the sense of «that which» (alladhī) ﴿يَدْعُونَ﴾ they worship — read with yāʾ and with tāʾ — ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ other than Him ﴿مِنْ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ﴾ in His dominion, ﴿الْحَكِيمُ﴾ in His making.

celaleyn:43-43.t: ﴿وَتِلْكَ الْأَمْثَالُ﴾ in the Qurʾān ﴿نَضْرِبُهَا﴾ We make them ﴿لِلنَّاسِ وَمَا يَعْقِلُهَا﴾ i.e. understands them ﴿إِلَّا الْعَالِمُونَ﴾ those who reflect.

celaleyn:44-44.t: ﴿خَلَقَ اللَّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ﴾ i.e. rightly; ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لَآيَةً﴾ indicating His power, exalted is He, ﴿لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ they are singled out for mention because they are the ones who benefit from it in faith, unlike the unbelievers.

celaleyn:45-45.t: ﴿اتْلُ مَا أُوحِيَ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ﴾ the Qurʾān, ﴿وَأَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ إِنَّ الصَّلَاةَ تَنْهَى عَنِ الْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنْكَرِ﴾ by the Sacred Law, i.e. that is its nature as long as a person is in it; ﴿وَلَذِكْرُ اللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ﴾ than other acts of obedience; ﴿وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَصْنَعُونَ﴾ and He will requite you for it.

celaleyn:46-46.t: ﴿وَلَا تُجَادِلُوا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ إِلَّا بِالَّتِي﴾ i.e. with the disputation that ﴿هِيَ أَحْسَنُ﴾ such as calling to Allah through His signs and drawing attention to His proofs, ﴿إِلَّا الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا مِنْهُمْ﴾ by waging war and refusing to accept the jizya: dispute with them by the sword until they submit to Islam or pay the jizya; ﴿وَقُولُوا﴾ to those who have accepted to pay the jizya, when they tell you something of what is in their books: ﴿آمَنَّا بِالَّذِي أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْنَا وَأُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ﴾ and neither believe them nor call them liars in that; ﴿وَإِلَهُنَا وَإِلَهُكُمْ وَاحِدٌ وَنَحْنُ لَهُ مُسْلِمُونَ﴾ obedient.

celaleyn:47-47.t: ﴿وَكَذَلِكَ أَنْزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ﴾ the Qurʾān, just as We sent down to them the Torah and other [scriptures]; ﴿فَالَّذِينَ آتَيْنَاهُمُ الْكِتَابَ﴾ the Torah, such as ʿAbd Allāh ibn Salām and others, ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ﴾ in the Qurʾān; ﴿وَمِنْ هَؤُلَاءِ﴾ i.e. the people of Mecca ﴿مَنْ يُؤْمِنُ بِهِ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِآيَاتِنَا﴾ after they have become manifest ﴿إِلَّا الْكَافِرُونَ﴾ i.e. the Jews; it had become clear to them that the Qurʾān is true and that the one who brought it is truthful, and they denied that.

celaleyn:48-48.t: ﴿وَمَا كُنْتَ تَتْلُوا مِنْ قَبْلِهِ﴾ i.e. the Qurʾān ﴿مِنْ كِتَابٍ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُ بِيَمِينِكَ إِذًا﴾ i.e. had you been one who reads and writes, ﴿لَارْتَابَ﴾ would have doubted ﴿الْمُبْطِلُونَ﴾ the Jews, about you, and they would have said: what is in the Torah is that he is unlettered, neither reading nor writing.

celaleyn:49-49.t: ﴿بَلْ هُوَ﴾ i.e. the Qurʾān that you have brought ﴿آيَاتٌ بَيِّنَاتٌ فِي صُدُورِ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ﴾ i.e. the believers, who memorise it; ﴿وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِآيَاتِنَا إِلَّا الظَّالِمُونَ﴾ i.e. the Jews; they denied them after they had become manifest to them.

celaleyn:50-50.t: ﴿وَقَالُوا﴾ i.e. the unbelievers of Mecca, ﴿لَوْلَا﴾ why not ﴿أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ﴾ i.e. Muḥammad ﴿آيَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِ﴾ — in one reading [آيَاتٌ] — such as the she-camel of Ṣāliḥ, the staff of Moses and the table of Jesus? ﴿قُلْ﴾ to them: ﴿إِنَّمَا الْآيَاتُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ﴾ He sends them down as He wills, ﴿وَإِنَّمَا أَنَا نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ﴾ making plain my warning of the Fire to the people of disobedience.

celaleyn:51-51.t: ﴿أَوَلَمْ يَكْفِهِمْ﴾ in what they asked for ﴿أَنَّا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ﴾ the Qurʾān ﴿يُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ — so it is an enduring sign that has no end, unlike the signs mentioned; ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ﴾ Book ﴿لَرَحْمَةً وَذِكْرَى﴾ an admonition ﴿لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾.

celaleyn:52-52.t: ﴿قُلْ كَفَى بِاللَّهِ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ شَهِيدًا﴾ to my truthfulness; ﴿يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ including my state and your state; ﴿وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِالْبَاطِلِ﴾ which is what is worshipped besides Allah, ﴿وَكَفَرُوا بِاللَّهِ﴾ among you, ﴿أُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ﴾ in their bargain, since they purchased unbelief in exchange for faith.

celaleyn:53-53.t: ﴿وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِالْعَذَابِ وَلَوْلَا أَجَلٌ مُسَمًّى﴾ for it, ﴿لَجَاءَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ﴾ immediately; ﴿وَلَيَأْتِيَنَّهُمْ بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ﴾ of the time of its coming.

celaleyn:54-54.t: ﴿يَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِالْعَذَابِ﴾ in this world, ﴿وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمُحِيطَةٌ بِالْكَافِرِينَ﴾.

celaleyn:55-55.t: ﴿يَوْمَ يَغْشَاهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ وَمِنْ تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِهِمْ وَنَقُولُ﴾ on it — with nūn, i.e. We command the saying, and [يَقُولُ] with yāʾ, i.e. the one in charge of the punishment says — ﴿ذُوقُوا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ i.e. its requital, for you will not escape Us.

celaleyn:56-56.t: ﴿يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنَّ أَرْضِي وَاسِعَةٌ فَإِيَّايَ فَاعْبُدُونِ﴾ in a land in which worship is made easy, by emigrating to it from a land in which it is not made easy. It was revealed concerning the weak Muslims of Mecca, who were in straits about practising Islam openly there.

celaleyn:57-57.t: ﴿كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَائِقَةُ الْمَوْتِ ثُمَّ إِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ﴾ read with tāʾ and with yāʾ, after the Resurrection.

celaleyn:58-58.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمْ﴾ We shall lodge them — and in one reading with thāʾ after the nūn [Translator's note: i.e. لَنُثْوِيَنَّهُمْ], from al-thawāʾ, residing; its taking غُرَفًا as object is by omission of فِي — ﴿مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ غُرَفًا تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ﴾ destined for everlasting life ﴿فِيهَا نِعْمَ أَجْرُ الْعَامِلِينَ﴾ this reward; they are:

celaleyn:59-59.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا﴾ on the harm of the idolaters, and on emigration for the sake of practising the religion openly, ﴿وَعَلَى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ﴾ so He provides for them from where they do not expect.

celaleyn:60-60.t: ﴿وَكَأَيِّنْ﴾ how many ﴿مِنْ دَابَّةٍ لَا تَحْمِلُ رِزْقَهَا﴾ because of its weakness: ﴿اللَّهُ يَرْزُقُهَا وَإِيَّاكُمْ﴾ O emigrants, even if you have neither provisions nor money with you; ﴿وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ﴾ of your words, ﴿الْعَلِيمُ﴾ of your innermost thoughts.

celaleyn:61-61.t: ﴿وَلَئِنْ﴾ the lām of oath, ﴿سَأَلْتَهُمْ﴾ i.e. the unbelievers, ﴿مَنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ فَأَنَّى يُؤْفَكُونَ﴾ are they turned away from His oneness after acknowledging that.

celaleyn:62-62.t: ﴿اللَّهُ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ﴾ expands it ﴿لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ﴾ as a test ﴿وَيَقْدِرُ﴾ restricts it ﴿لَهُ﴾ after the expansion, i.e. for whomever He wills to try; ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ﴾ including where expansion and restriction belong.

celaleyn:63-63.t: ﴿وَلَئِنْ﴾ the lām of oath, ﴿سَأَلْتَهُمْ مَنْ نَزَّلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَحْيَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَوْتِهَا لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ﴾ so how can they associate partners with Him? ﴿قُلْ﴾ to them: ﴿الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ﴾ for the proof being established against you; ﴿بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ﴾ their self-contradiction in that.

celaleyn:64-64.t: ﴿وَمَا هَذِهِ الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا لَهْوٌ وَلَعِبٌ﴾ — as for acts that bring one near [to Allah], they belong to the affairs of the Hereafter, because their fruit appears there — ﴿وَإِنَّ الدَّارَ الْآخِرَةَ لَهِيَ الْحَيَوَانُ﴾ in the sense of life, ﴿لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ that, they would not have preferred this world to it.

celaleyn:65-65.t: ﴿فَإِذَا رَكِبُوا فِي الْفُلْكِ دَعَوُا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ﴾ i.e. the supplication, i.e. they do not call on anyone else with Him, because they are in a hardship that none but He can remove; ﴿فَلَمَّا نَجَّاهُمْ إِلَى الْبَرِّ إِذَا هُمْ يُشْرِكُونَ﴾ Him.

celaleyn:66-66.t: ﴿لِيَكْفُرُوا بِمَا آتَيْنَاهُمْ﴾ of blessing, ﴿وَلِيَتَمَتَّعُوا﴾ in their gathering together to worship idols — and in one reading with sukūn on the lām, an imperative of threat — ﴿فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ the outcome of that.

celaleyn:67-67.t: ﴿أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا﴾ know ﴿أَنَّا جَعَلْنَا﴾ their town, Mecca, ﴿حَرَمًا آمِنًا وَيُتَخَطَّفُ النَّاسُ مِنْ حَوْلِهِمْ﴾ by killing and capture, but not them? ﴿أَفَبِالْبَاطِلِ﴾ the idol ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ وَبِنِعْمَةِ اللَّهِ يَكْفُرُونَ﴾ by their associating partners [with Him]?

celaleyn:68-68.t: ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ i.e. no one ﴿أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرَى عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا﴾ by associating partners with Him, ﴿أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِالْحَقِّ﴾ the Prophet or the Book, ﴿لَمَّا جَاءَهُ أَلَيْسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى﴾ an abode ﴿لِلْكَافِرِينَ﴾ i.e. it is there, and he is one of them.

celaleyn:69-69.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوا فِينَا﴾ for Our sake, ﴿لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا﴾ i.e. the way of journeying to Us; ﴿وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَمَعَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾ the believers, with help and support.

celaleyn:1-1.t: ﴿الم﴾ Allah knows best what He means by it.

celaleyn:2-2.t: ﴿أَحَسِبَ النَّاسُ أَنْ يُتْرَكُوا أَنْ يَقُولُوا﴾ i.e. because of their saying ﴿آمَنَّا وَهُمْ لَا يُفْتَنُونَ﴾ tested with that by which the reality of their faith becomes clear. It was revealed about a group who believed and whom the idolaters then harmed.

celaleyn:3-3.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ صَدَقُوا﴾ in their faith, with a knowledge of witnessing ﴿وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ الْكَاذِبِينَ﴾ in it.

celaleyn:4-4.t: ﴿أَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ السَّيِّئَاتِ﴾ associating partners and acts of disobedience ﴿أَنْ يَسْبِقُونَا﴾ escape Us, so that We do not take vengeance on them ﴿سَاءَ﴾ evil is ﴿مَا﴾ that which ﴿يَحْكُمُونَ﴾ -hu [i.e. yaḥkumūnahu, with the returning pronoun]; this judgement of theirs [is what is blamed].

celaleyn:5-5.t: ﴿مَنْ كَانَ يَرْجُوا﴾ fears ﴿لِقَاءَ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّ أَجَلَ اللَّهِ﴾ for it ﴿لَآتٍ﴾ so let him prepare for it ﴿وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ﴾ of the servants' words ﴿الْعَلِيمُ﴾ of their deeds.

celaleyn:6-6.t: ﴿وَمَنْ جَاهَدَ﴾ a jihād of war or of the self ﴿فَإِنَّمَا يُجَاهِدُ لِنَفْسِهِ﴾ for the benefit of his striving is his, not Allah's ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَغَنِيٌّ عَنِ الْعَالَمِينَ﴾ humans, jinn and angels, and of their worship.

celaleyn:7-7.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَنُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ﴾ through doing righteous deeds ﴿وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَحْسَنَ﴾ in the sense of ḥasan (good); it is accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ ﴿الَّذِي كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ and that is the righteous deeds.

celaleyn:8-8.t: ﴿وَوَصَّيْنَا الْإِنْسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ حُسْنًا﴾ i.e. a charge of goodness, that he be dutiful to them ﴿وَإِنْ جَاهَدَاكَ لِتُشْرِكَ بِي مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ﴾ of its being associated ﴿عِلْمٌ﴾ in agreement with reality, so it has no implied converse meaning (mafhūm) ﴿فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَا﴾ in associating partners ﴿إِلَيَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ and I will recompense you for it.

celaleyn:9-9.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَنُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ فِي الصَّالِحِينَ﴾ the prophets and the saints (awliyāʾ), by gathering them with them.

celaleyn:10-10.t: ﴿وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يَقُولُ آمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ فَإِذَا أُوذِيَ فِي اللَّهِ جَعَلَ فِتْنَةَ النَّاسِ﴾ i.e. their harming him ﴿كَعَذَابِ اللَّهِ﴾ in fearing it, so he obeys them and becomes a hypocrite ﴿وَلَئِنْ﴾ a lām of oath ﴿جَاءَ نَصْرٌ﴾ for the believers ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾ and they take spoils ﴿لَيَقُولُنَّ﴾ the nūn of the nominative has been dropped from it because of the succession of nūns, and the wāw, the plural pronoun, because of the meeting of two sākin letters ﴿إِنَّا كُنَّا مَعَكُمْ﴾ in faith, so give us a share in the spoils. The Exalted said: ﴿أَوَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِأَعْلَمَ﴾ i.e. knowing ﴿بِمَا فِي صُدُورِ الْعَالَمِينَ﴾ their hearts, of faith and hypocrisy? Yes indeed.

celaleyn:11-11.t: ﴿وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾ with their hearts ﴿وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ﴾ and He will recompense both parties; the lām in both verbs is a lām of oath.

celaleyn:12-12.t: ﴿وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّبِعُوا سَبِيلَنَا﴾ our religion ﴿وَلْنَحْمِلْ خَطَايَاكُمْ﴾ in following us, if there are any; the command is in the sense of a statement (khabar). The Exalted said: ﴿وَمَا هُمْ بِحَامِلِينَ مِنْ خَطَايَاهُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ إِنَّهُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ﴾ in that.

celaleyn:13-13.t: ﴿وَلَيَحْمِلُنَّ أَثْقَالَهُمْ﴾ their burdens [of sin] ﴿وَأَثْقَالًا مَعَ أَثْقَالِهِمْ﴾ for their saying to the believers {اتَّبِعُوا سَبِيلَنَا} and their misleading those who imitate them ﴿وَلَيُسْأَلُنَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَمَةِ عَمَّا كَانُوا يَفْتَرُونَ﴾ lie against Allah — a questioning of rebuke. The lām in both verbs is a lām of oath, and their agent (fāʿil), the wāw, and the nūn of the nominative have been dropped.

celaleyn:14-14.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِ﴾ when he was forty years old or more ﴿فَلَبِثَ فِيهِمْ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ إِلَّا خَمْسِينَ عَامًا﴾ calling them to the oneness of Allah, but they denied him ﴿فَأَخَذَهُمُ الطُّوفَانُ﴾ i.e. the abundant water which surrounded them and rose over them, so they drowned ﴿وَهُمْ ظَالِمُونَ﴾ idolaters.

celaleyn:15-15.t: ﴿فَأَنْجَيْنَاهُ﴾ i.e. Noah ﴿وَأَصْحَابَ السَّفِينَةِ﴾ i.e. those who were with him in it ﴿وَجَعَلْنَاهَا آيَةً﴾ a lesson ﴿لِلْعَالَمِينَ﴾ for the people after them, if they disobey their messengers. Noah lived after the Flood sixty years or more, until people became numerous.

celaleyn:16-16.t: ﴿وَ﴾ remember ﴿إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ وَاتَّقُوهُ﴾ fear His punishment ﴿ذَلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ﴾ than the worship of idols that you practise ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ good from other than it.

celaleyn:17-17.t: ﴿إِنَّمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ﴾ i.e. other than Him ﴿أَوْثَانًا وَتَخْلُقُونَ إِفْكًا﴾ you say falsely that the idols are partners of Allah ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ تَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لَكُمْ رِزْقًا﴾ they are unable to provide for you ﴿فَابْتَغُوا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ الرِّزْقَ﴾ seek it from Him ﴿وَاعْبُدُوهُ وَاشْكُرُوا لَهُ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ﴾

celaleyn:18-18.t: ﴿وَإِنْ تُكَذِّبُوا﴾ i.e. you deny me, O people of Mecca ﴿فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أُمَمٌ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ﴾ before me ﴿وَمَا عَلَى الرَّسُولِ إِلَّا الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ﴾ only the clear conveying. In these two stories there is consolation for the Prophet ﷺ. And the Exalted said about his people:

celaleyn:19-19.t: ﴿أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا﴾ with yāʾ and with tāʾ: look ﴿كَيْفَ يُبْدِئُ اللَّهُ الْخَلْقَ﴾ it is with ḍamma on its first letter, and it has been read with fatḥa on it, from badaʾa and abdaʾa, with the same meaning, i.e. He creates them in the first place ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ He ﴿يُعِيدُهُ﴾ the creation, as He began them ﴿إِنَّ ذَلِكَ﴾ what has been mentioned, of the first and the second creation ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ﴾ so how can they deny the second?

celaleyn:20-20.t: ﴿قُلْ سِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَانْظُرُوا كَيْفَ بَدَأَ الْخَلْقَ﴾ of those who were before you, and caused them to die ﴿ثُمَّ اللَّهُ يُنْشِئُ النَّشَاءَةَ الْآخِرَةَ﴾ with lengthening and with shortening together with sukūn on the shīn [النَّشْأَةَ] ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ﴾ and part of that is beginning and restoring.

celaleyn:21-21.t: ﴿يُعَذِّبُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ﴾ to punish ﴿وَيَرْحَمُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ﴾ to show mercy to ﴿وَإِلَيْهِ تُقْلَبُونَ﴾ you will be returned.

celaleyn:22-22.t: ﴿وَمَا أَنْتُمْ بِمُعْجِزِينَ﴾ your Lord from overtaking you ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ﴾ were you in it, i.e. you cannot escape Him ﴿وَمَا لَكُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ﴾ i.e. other than Him ﴿مِنْ وَلِيٍّ﴾ to protect you from Him ﴿وَلَا نَصِيرٍ﴾ to help you against His punishment.

celaleyn:23-23.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ وَلِقَائِهِ﴾ i.e. the Qurʾan and the resurrection ﴿أُولَئِكَ يَئِسُوا مِنْ رَحْمَتِي﴾ i.e. My Paradise ﴿وَأُولَئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ﴾ painful.

celaleyn:24-24.t: The Exalted said in the story of Abraham, peace be upon him: ﴿فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِ إِلَّا أَنْ قَالُوا اقْتُلُوهُ أَوْ حَرِّقُوهُ فَأَنْجَاهُ اللَّهُ مِنَ النَّارِ﴾ into which they had thrown him, by making it coolness and safety for him ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ﴾ i.e. in His saving him from it ﴿لَآيَاتٍ﴾ they are its having no effect on him despite its greatness, its being put out, and the bringing forth of a garden in its place in a short time ﴿لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ who affirm the oneness of Allah and His power, because they are the ones who benefit from them.

celaleyn:25-25.t: ﴿وَقَالَ﴾ Abraham ﴿إِنَّمَا اتَّخَذْتُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَوْثَانًا﴾ which you worship, and mā is maṣdariyya (forming a maṣdar) ﴿مَوَدَّةُ بَيْنِكُمْ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of inna; and on the reading with the accusative it is a mafʿūl lahu (object of purpose) and mā is the restraining [mā] (kāffa). The meaning is: you have loved one another over worshipping them ﴿فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَمَةِ يَكْفُرُ بَعْضُكُمْ بِبَعْضٍ﴾ the leaders will disown the followers ﴿وَيَلْعَنُ بَعْضُكُمْ بَعْضًا﴾ the followers will curse the leaders ﴿وَمَأْوَاكُمْ﴾ your destination, all of you ﴿النَّارُ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِنْ نَاصِرِينَ﴾ to protect you from it.

celaleyn:26-26.t: ﴿فَآمَنَ لَهُ﴾ believed in Abraham ﴿لُوطٌ﴾ he was the son of his brother Hārān ﴿وَقَالَ﴾ Abraham ﴿إِنِّي مُهَاجِرٌ﴾ from my people ﴿إِلَى رَبِّي﴾ i.e. to where my Lord has commanded me; and he left his people and emigrated from the Sawād of Iraq to Syria ﴿إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ﴾ in His dominion ﴿الْحَكِيمُ﴾ in His making.

celaleyn:27-27.t: ﴿وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ﴾ after Ishmael ﴿إِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ﴾ after Isaac ﴿وَجَعَلْنَا فِي ذُرِّيَّتِهِ النُّبُوَّةَ﴾ so all the prophets after Abraham are of his descendants ﴿وَالْكِتَابَ﴾ in the sense of the Books, i.e. the Torah, the Gospel, the Psalms and the Furqān ﴿وَآتَيْنَاهُ أَجْرَهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا﴾ and that is good praise among the people of all religions ﴿وَإِنَّهُ فِي الْآخِرَةِ لَمِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ﴾ who have the highest ranks.

celaleyn:28-28.t: ﴿وَ﴾ remember ﴿لُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ أَإِنَّكُمْ﴾ with both hamzas pronounced fully and with the second softened, and with an alif inserted between them in both ways, in both places [إِنَّكُمْ] ﴿لَتَأْتُونَ الْفَاحِشَةَ﴾ i.e. the backsides of men ﴿مَا سَبَقَكُمْ بِهَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِنَ الْعَالَمِينَ﴾ humans and jinn.

celaleyn:29-29.t: ﴿أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ الرِّجَالَ وَتَقْطَعُونَ السَّبِيلَ﴾ the travellers' road, by committing indecency with whoever passes by you, so that people stopped passing by you ﴿وَتَأْتُونَ فِي نَادِيكُمْ﴾ your place of gathering ﴿الْمُنْكَرَ﴾ committing indecency with one another ﴿فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِ إِلَّا أَنْ قَالُوا ائْتِنَا بِعَذَابِ اللَّهِ إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ﴾ in deeming that abominable, and that punishment will descend on those who do it.

celaleyn:30-30.t: ﴿قَالَ رَبِّ انْصُرْنِي﴾ by fulfilling my word about sending down punishment ﴿عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْمُفْسِدِينَ﴾ who disobey by approaching men. So Allah answered his prayer.

celaleyn:31-31.t: ﴿وَلَمَّا جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ بِالْبُشْرَى﴾ of Isaac and Jacob after him ﴿قَالُوا إِنَّا مُهْلِكُوا أَهْلِ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ﴾ i.e. the town of Lot ﴿إِنَّ أَهْلَهَا كَانُوا ظَالِمِينَ﴾ disbelievers.

celaleyn:32-32.t: ﴿قَالَ﴾ Abraham ﴿إِنَّ فِيهَا لُوطًا﴾ ﴿قَالُوا﴾ i.e. the messengers ﴿نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ فِيهَا لَنُنَجِّيَنَّهُ﴾ with the light and the doubled form [لَنُنْجِيَنَّهُ] ﴿وَأَهْلَهُ إِلَّا امْرَأَتَهُ كَانَتْ مِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ﴾ those remaining in the punishment.

celaleyn:33-33.t: ﴿وَلَمَّا أَنْ جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًا سِيءَ بِهِمْ﴾ he was grieved because of them ﴿وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًا﴾ in heart, because they were handsome of face, in the form of guests, so he feared his people for them; so they informed him that they were his Lord's messengers ﴿وَقَالُوا لَا تَخَفْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ إِنَّا مُنَجُّوكَ﴾ with the doubled and the light form ﴿وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا امْرَأَتَكَ كَانَتْ مِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ﴾; أَهْلَكَ is accusative as conjoined to the position (maḥall) of the kāf.

celaleyn:34-34.t: ﴿إِنَّا مُنْزِلُونَ﴾ with the light and the doubled form ﴿عَلَى أَهْلِ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ رِجْزًا﴾ a punishment ﴿مِنَ السَّمَاءِ بِمَا﴾ for the deed which ﴿كَانُوا يَفْسُقُونَ﴾ in, i.e. because of their transgression.

celaleyn:35-35.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ تَرَكْنَا مِنْهَا آيَةً بَيِّنَةً﴾ manifest; it is the traces of its ruin ﴿لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ﴾ who reflect.

daas-irab:1-2.t: ﴿الم﴾: its i'rab has been given previously under the opening letters of the surahs. ﴿أَحَسِبَ﴾: the hamza is a particle of interrogation and rebuke; ﴿حَسِبَ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿النَّاسُ﴾ fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَنْ﴾ a subjunctive particle. ﴿يُتْرَكُوا﴾ a passive imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by «أن», the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from «أن» and the verb stands in place of the two objects of «حسب». ﴿أَنْ﴾ a subjunctive particle. ﴿يَقُولُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by «أن», the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar formed from «أن» and the verb is accusative by removal of the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), the implied form being «بقولهم» ("by their saying"). ﴿آمَنَّا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يُفْتَنُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:10-10.t: ﴿وَمِنَ النَّاسِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنَ﴾ a relative noun, a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject) «[Translator's note: the Quranic word is «مَنْ»; the source prints it as «مِنَ».]»; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَقُولُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is a ṣila (relative clause). ﴿آمَنَّا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ attached to the verb; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَإِذا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿إذا﴾ an adverbial, non-jussive conditional. ﴿أُوذِيَ﴾ a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent. ﴿فِي اللَّهِ﴾ attached to the verb; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿جَعَلَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿فِتْنَةَ النَّاسِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), annexed to «الناس», and «الناس» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿كَعَذابِ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلَئِنْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, the lām prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam), and «إن» is a jussive conditional particle. ﴿جاءَ نَصْرٌ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾ attached to «نصر»; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿لَيَقُولُنَّ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer to the oath, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, which has been dropped to avoid a succession of identical letters; the wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is its fāʿil, and the nūn is for emphasis; the clause is the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّا كُنَّا﴾ «إن» and its noun, and «كان» and its noun. ﴿مَعَكُمْ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to an omitted khabar of «كان»; the verbal clause is the khabar of «إن», and the clause «إنا..» is the object of the saying. ﴿أَوَلَيْسَ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, the wāw is resumptive, and a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, its noun «[Translator's note: so vowelled in the source; as the noun of «ليس» it is «اللَّهُ».]». ﴿بِأَعْلَمَ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; ﴿أعلم﴾ genitive in form by the bāʾ, accusative in position as the khabar of «ليس»; the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِما﴾ attached to «أعلم». ﴿فِي صُدُورِ﴾ attached to an omitted ṣila of «ما». ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:11-11.t: ﴿وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, the lām occurs in the answer to an omitted oath, and an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Divine Name, fāʿil (agent). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the answer to the implied oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ الْمُنافِقِينَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it, and the i'rab is clear.

daas-irab:12-12.t: ﴿وَقالَ الَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb «قال». ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a ṣila. ﴿اتَّبِعُوا سَبِيلَنا﴾ an imperative verb with its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَلْنَحْمِلْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿خَطاياكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿ما﴾ negative, operating like «ليس». ﴿هُمْ﴾ ﴿بِحامِلِينَ﴾ its noun; and the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; ﴿حاملين﴾ genitive in form, accusative in position as the khabar (predicate) of «ما». ﴿مِنْ خَطاياهُمْ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنْ شَيْءٍ﴾ genitive in form by «من», accusative in position as the object of «حاملين»; the clause «ما هم..» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾ «إن» and its noun. ﴿لَكاذِبُونَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) and the khabar of «إن»; the nominal clause emphasizes what precedes it and, like it, has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:13-13.t: ﴿وَلَيَحْمِلُنَّ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, the lām occurs in the answer to the oath, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, which has been dropped because of the succession of identical letters; and the wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَثْقالَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَثْقالًا﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «أثقالهم». ﴿مَعَ أَثْقالِهِمْ﴾ «مع» is an adverb of place, annexed to «أثقالهم». ﴿وَلَيُسْئَلُنَّ﴾ conjoined to «ليحملن». ﴿يَوْمَ الْقِيامَةِ﴾ an adverb of time, annexed to «القيامة». ﴿عَمَّا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb before them. ﴿كانُوا﴾ «كان» and its noun. ﴿يَفْتَرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «كانوا», and the clause «كانوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «ما», with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:14-14.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a particle of oath and of the genitive, the lām occurs in the answer to the oath, and «قد» is a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿أَرْسَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿نُوحاً﴾ its object; the clause is the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِلى قَوْمِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿فَلَبِثَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿فِيهِمْ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ﴾ an adverb of time, annexed to «سنة»; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿خَمْسِينَ﴾ excepted by «إلا», accusative (manṣūb). ﴿عاماً﴾ tamyīz (specification). ﴿فَأَخَذَهُمُ﴾ a past verb and its object. ﴿الطُّوفانُ﴾ a delayed fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَهُمْ ظالِمُونَ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:15-15.t: ﴿فَأَنْجَيْناهُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb with its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿أَصْحابَ﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿السَّفِينَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَجَعَلْناها﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb with its fāʿil and its first object. ﴿آيَةً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لِلْعالَمِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «آية». The clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:16-16.t: ﴿وَإِبْراهِيمَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and «إبراهيم» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «نوحا». ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time, badal (substitute) of «إبراهيم». ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿لِقَوْمِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the Divine Name is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَاتَّقُوهُ﴾ conjoined to «اعبدوا». ﴿ذلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ attached to «خير». ﴿إِنْ﴾ a jussive conditional particle. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ «كان» and its noun. ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of «كنتم», and the clause «كنتم..» is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted.

daas-irab:17-17.t: ﴿إِنَّما﴾ the restraining and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿تَعْبُدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is a ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb, and the Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَوْثاناً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَتَخْلُقُونَ﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «تعبدون». ﴿إِفْكاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾ «إن» and its noun. ﴿تَعْبُدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is a ṣila. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and the Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا يَمْلِكُونَ﴾ negative, and an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿رِزْقاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «إن». ﴿فَابْتَغُوا﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa [fāʾ, implying an unstated condition], and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb) of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿عِنْدَ اللَّهِ﴾ an adverb of place, annexed to the Divine Name. ﴿الرِّزْقَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَاعْبُدُوهُ﴾ an imperative verb with its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَاشْكُرُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لَهُ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ attached to the verb after them. ﴿تُرْجَعُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

daas-irab:18-18.t: ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and «إن» is a jussive conditional particle. ﴿تُكَذِّبُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿فَقَدْ﴾ the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa); ﴿قد﴾ a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿كَذَّبَ أُمَمٌ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ﴾ naʿt (adjective) of «أمم»; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle; ﴿ما﴾ negative. ﴿عَلَى الرَّسُولِ﴾ a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿الْبَلاغُ﴾ a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْمُبِينُ﴾ naʿt; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:19-19.t: ﴿أَوَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation, and the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿يَرَوْا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لم», and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾ an interrogative noun, ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يُبْدِئُ اللَّهُ الْخَلْقَ﴾ an imperfect verb with its fāʿil and its object; the clause stands in place of the object of «يروا». ﴿ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ﴾ a conjunction, and an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِنَّ ذلِكَ﴾ «إن» and its noun. ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the khabar (predicate) ﴿يَسِيرٌ﴾; the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīl).

daas-irab:20-20.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿سِيرُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَانْظُرُوا﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «سيروا». ﴿كَيْفَ﴾ an interrogative noun, ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿بَدَأَ الْخَلْقَ﴾ a past verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the object of «انظروا». ﴿ثُمَّ اللَّهُ﴾ a conjunction, and the Divine Name is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يُنْشِئُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿النَّشْأَةَ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿الْآخِرَةَ﴾ naʿt (adjective); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ «إن» and its noun. ﴿عَلى كُلِّ﴾ attached to the khabar ﴿قَدِيرٌ﴾. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is causal (taʿlīl).

daas-irab:21-21.t: ﴿يُعَذِّبُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿مَنْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of «من». ﴿وَيَرْحَمُ﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «يعذب». ﴿مَنْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is a ṣila. ﴿وَإِلَيْهِ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached (mutaʿalliq) to what comes after them. ﴿تُقْلَبُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:22-22.t: ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle; ﴿ما﴾ negative, operating like «ليس». ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾ its noun. ﴿بِمُعْجِزِينَ﴾ genitive in form by the redundant (zāʾida) bāʾ, accusative in position as the khabar (predicate) of «ما». ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿فِي السَّماءِ﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «في الأرض». ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿ما﴾ negative. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ attached to an omitted, fronted khabar. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ﴾ attached to what the preposition and genitive noun before them are attached to, and the Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant preposition. ﴿وَلِيٍّ﴾ genitive in form, nominative in position as a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ redundant. ﴿نَصِيرٍ﴾ conjoined to «ولي».

daas-irab:23-23.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is a ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِآياتِ اللَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb, and the Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَلِقائِهِ﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «آيات». ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَئِسُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of «أولئك», the nominal clause «أولئك..» is the khabar of «الذين», and the clause «الذين..» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ رَحْمَتِي﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿وَأُولئِكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿لَهُمْ عَذابٌ﴾: ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a fronted khabar and ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ a delayed mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَلِيمٌ﴾ naʿt (adjective); the clause is the khabar of «أولئك», and the clause «أولئك لهم» is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:3-3.t:
﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a particle of oath and of the genitive, and the lām occurs in the answer to the oath; ﴿قد﴾ a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿فَتَنَّا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the clause is the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position.
﴿فَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, the lām occurs in the answer to the oath, and an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Divine Name, fāʿil. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿صَدَقُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of «الذين», with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ الْكاذِبِينَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it, and its i'rab is clear.

daas-irab:4-4.t: ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿حَسِبَ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿السَّيِّئاتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a subjunctive particle. ﴿يَسْبِقُونا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by «أن», the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; and «نا» is the mafʿūl bihi, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from «أن» and the verb stands in place of the two objects of «حسب». ﴿ساءَ﴾ an invariable (jāmid) past verb. ﴿ما﴾ maṣdarī (infinitival). ﴿يَحْكُمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar formed from «ما» and the verb is in the position of the nominative as fāʿil. The clause «ساء ما يحكمون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:5-5.t: ﴿مَنْ﴾ a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its noun is latent (mustatir). ﴿يَرْجُوا﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent. ﴿لِقاءَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «كان». ﴿فَإِنَّ﴾ the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and «إن» is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿أَجَلَ﴾ its noun. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi; and the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿آت﴾ the khabar of «إن»; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «من». ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ﴾ two khabars; the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:6-6.t: ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle; ﴿مَنْ﴾ a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿جاهَدَ﴾ a past verb in the position of the jussive, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿فَإِنَّما﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); ﴿إنما﴾ the restraining and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿يُجاهِدُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لِنَفْسِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis are the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ «إن», and the Divine Name is its noun. ﴿لَغَنِيٌّ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿غني﴾ the khabar of «إن». ﴿عَنِ الْعالَمِينَ﴾ attached to «غني»; the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīl).

daas-irab:7-7.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is a ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَعَمِلُوا﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «آمنوا». ﴿الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لَنُكَفِّرَنَّ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer to an omitted oath; «نكفرن» an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَنْهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿سَيِّئاتِهِمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the answer to the omitted oath, and the omitted oath together with its answer is the khabar (predicate) of «الذين». ﴿وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; the lām occurs in the answer to an omitted oath; «نجزينهم» an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿أَحْسَنَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿كانُوا﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb and its noun; the clause is the ṣila of «الذين» «[Translator's note: so in the source; the relative noun here is «الذي».]». ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of «كانوا».

daas-irab:8-8.t: ﴿وَوَصَّيْنَا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْإِنْسانَ﴾ its object; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿بِوالِدَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿حُسْناً﴾ naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional, jussive. ﴿جاهَداكَ﴾ a past verb with its fāʿil and its object; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿لِتُشْرِكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied «أن» after the lām of causation; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from «أن» and what follows it is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to what precedes them. ﴿بِي﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لَيْسَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لَكَ﴾ attached to the omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿بِهِ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿عِلْمٌ﴾ the delayed noun of «ليس»; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of «ما», with no grammatical position. ﴿فَلا تُطِعْهُما﴾ the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لا»; the hāʾ is its object and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿إِلَيَّ﴾ attached to an omitted, fronted khabar. ﴿مَرْجِعُكُمْ﴾ a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَأُنَبِّئُكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿بِما﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ «كان» and its noun. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of «كنتم», and the clause «كنتم..» is the ṣila of «ما».

daas-irab:9-9.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject), and a past verb with its fāʿil (agent); the clause is a ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَعَمِلُوا﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «آمنوا». ﴿الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لَنُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer to the oath, and an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿فِي الصَّالِحِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; the clause is the answer to the oath, and the oath together with its answer is the khabar (predicate) of «الذين», and the clause «الذين..» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:24-24.t: ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction and «ما» is negative. ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿جَوابَ قَوْمِهِ﴾ the fronted khabar (predicate) of «كان», annexed to «قومه». ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْ﴾ an infinitival and subjunctive particle. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from «أن» and the verb is the delayed noun of «كان», and the clause «فما كان..» is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿اقْتُلُوهُ﴾ an imperative verb with its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿حَرِّقُوهُ﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «اقتلوه». ﴿فَأَنْجاهُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿أنجاه الله﴾ a past verb and its object, and the Divine Name is the fāʿil. The clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مِنَ النَّارِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a particle resembling the verb «[Translator's note: the Quranic word is «إِنَّ»; the source prints it as «أَنْ».]». ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾ attached to an omitted, fronted khabar of «إن». ﴿لَآياتٍ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) and the delayed noun of «إن»; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of «آيات», and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is a naʿt of «قوم».

daas-irab:25-25.t: ﴿وَقالَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِنَّمَا﴾ the restraining and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿اتَّخَذْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb, and the Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَوْثاناً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مَوَدَّةَ﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿بَيْنِكُمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِي الْحَياةِ﴾ attached to «اتخذتم». ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ naʿt (adjective) of «الحياة». ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿يَوْمَ الْقِيامَةِ﴾ an adverb of time, annexed to «القيامة». ﴿يَكْفُرُ بَعْضُكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِبَعْضٍ﴾ attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَيَلْعَنُ بَعْضُكُمْ بَعْضاً﴾ an imperfect verb with its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَمَأْواكُمُ النَّارُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿ما﴾ negative. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a fronted khabar. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿ناصِرِينَ﴾ genitive in form, nominative in position as a delayed mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:26-26.t: ﴿فَآمَنَ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿لُوطٌ﴾ fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَقالَ﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «آمن». ﴿إِنِّي مُهاجِرٌ﴾ «إن», its noun and its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِلى رَبِّي﴾ attached to «مهاجر». ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ «إن» and its noun. ﴿هُوَ﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ﴾ two khabars; the clause is causal (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:27-27.t: ﴿وَوَهَبْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿إِسْحاقَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَيَعْقُوبَ﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «إسحاق»; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَجَعَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فِي ذُرِّيَّتِهِ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿النُّبُوَّةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَالْكِتابَ﴾ conjoined to «النبوة». ﴿وَآتَيْناهُ﴾ a past verb with its fāʿil and its first object. ﴿أَجْرَهُ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فِي الدُّنْيا﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَإِنَّهُ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «إن» and its noun. ﴿فِي الْآخِرَةِ﴾ attached to the omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿لَمِنَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿من الصالحين﴾ attached to an omitted khabar of «إن»; the nominal clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:28-28.t: ﴿وَلُوطاً﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «إبراهيم». ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time, badal (substitute) of «لوطا». ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿لِقَوْمِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿إِنَّكُمْ﴾ «إن» and its noun. ﴿لَتَأْتُونَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿الْفاحِشَةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», and the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿ما﴾ negative. ﴿سَبَقَكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its object. ﴿بِها﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿مِنْ أَحَدٍ﴾ genitive in form by the redundant (zāʾida) «من», nominative in position as the fāʿil of «سبقكم»; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنَ الْعالَمِينَ﴾ attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «أحد».

daas-irab:29-29.t: ﴿أَإِنَّكُمْ﴾ the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation, and «إن» and its noun. ﴿لَتَأْتُونَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», and the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿الرِّجالَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَتَقْطَعُونَ السَّبِيلَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَتَأْتُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿فِي نادِيكُمُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿الْمُنْكَرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿ما﴾ negative. ﴿كانَ جَوابَ﴾ «كان» and its fronted khabar. ﴿قَوْمِهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْ﴾ an infinitival particle. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from «أن» and the verb is in the position of the nominative as the delayed noun of «كان», and the clause «فما كان..» is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿ائْتِنا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; «نا» is the mafʿūl bihi and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿بِعَذابِ اللَّهِ﴾ attached to the verb, and the Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَنْ﴾ conditional, jussive «[Translator's note: the Quranic word is «إِنْ»; the source prints it as «أَنْ».]». ﴿كُنْتَ﴾ «كان» and its noun. ﴿مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ﴾ its khabar; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted.

daas-irab:30-30.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿رَبِّ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the yāʾ of the first person, which has been dropped for lightness. ﴿انْصُرْنِي﴾ a verb of supplication whose fāʿil is latent; the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya) and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿عَلَى الْقَوْمِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿الْمُفْسِدِينَ﴾ naʿt (adjective) of «قوم»; the two clauses, the vocative and the verbal, are the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:31-31.t: ﴿وَلَمَّا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿لَمَّا﴾ adverbial, conditional. ﴿جاءَتْ رُسُلُنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿إِبْراهِيمَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بِالْبُشْرى﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿إِنَّا مُهْلِكُوا﴾ «إن», its noun and its khabar (predicate). ﴿أَهْلِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿هذِهِ﴾ the demonstrative, also muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْقَرْيَةِ﴾ badal (substitute) of «هذه»; the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنَّ أَهْلَها﴾ «إن» and its noun. ﴿كانُوا ظالِمِينَ﴾ «كان», its noun and its khabar; the verbal clause is the khabar of «إن», and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīl).

daas-irab:32-32.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿فِيها﴾ a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿لُوطاً﴾ the delayed noun of «إن»; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿بِمَنْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to «أعلم». ﴿فِيها﴾ attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿لَنُنَجِّيَنَّهُ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer to the oath, and an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَأَهْلَهُ﴾ mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿امْرَأَتَهُ﴾ excepted, accusative (manṣūb). ﴿كانَتْ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; its noun is latent. ﴿مِنَ الْغابِرِينَ﴾ the khabar of «كانت»; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:33-33.t: ﴿وَلَمَّا﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle; ﴿لَمَّا﴾ adverbial, conditional, non-jussive. ﴿أَنْ جاءَتْ﴾ «أن» is redundant (zāʾida), and a past verb. ﴿رُسُلُنا﴾ fāʿil (agent). ﴿لُوطاً﴾ its object; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿سِيءَ﴾ a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿بِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَضاقَ﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to what precedes it. ﴿بِهِمْ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿ذَرْعاً﴾ tamyīz (specification). ﴿وَقالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿لا تَخَفْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive «لا», and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَلا تَحْزَنْ﴾ conjoined to «لا تخف». ﴿إِنَّا مُنَجُّوكَ﴾ «إن», its noun and its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīl). ﴿وَأَهْلَكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿امْرَأَتَكَ﴾ excepted, accusative (manṣūb). ﴿كانَتْ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; its noun is latent. ﴿مِنَ الْغابِرِينَ﴾ the khabar of «كانت»; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:34-34.t: ﴿إِنَّا﴾ «إن» and its noun. ﴿مُنْزِلُونَ﴾ its khabar (predicate); the clause is causal (taʿlīl). ﴿عَلى أَهْلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to what precedes them. ﴿هذِهِ﴾ the demonstrative, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْقَرْيَةِ﴾ badal (substitute) of the demonstrative. ﴿رِجْزاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «منزلون». ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾ attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «رجزا». ﴿بِما﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition; ﴿ما﴾ maṣdarī (infinitival), and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from «ما» and what follows it is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «منزلون». ﴿كانُوا﴾ «كان» and its noun. ﴿يَفْسُقُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar of «كانوا».

daas-irab:35-35.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a particle of oath and of the genitive, the lām occurs in the answer to the oath, and «قد» is a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿تَرَكْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿آيَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بَيِّنَةً﴾ naʿt (adjective); the clause is the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿يَعْقِلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is a naʿt of «قوم».

daas-irab:36-36.t: ﴿وَإِلى مَدْيَنَ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted verb, its implied form being "أرسلنا إلى مدين" ("We sent to Madyan"). ﴿أَخاهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the omitted verb. ﴿شُعَيْباً﴾ badal (substitute). ﴿فَقالَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿قال﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿يا قَوْمِ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the dropped yāʾ of the first person; the vocative clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ﴾ an imperative verb with its fāʿil and its object; the clause is also the object of the saying. ﴿وَارْجُوا الْيَوْمَ﴾ an imperative verb with its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿الْآخِرَ﴾ naʿt (adjective). ﴿وَلا تَعْثَوْا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive «لا», and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿مُفْسِدِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:37-37.t: ﴿فَكَذَّبُوهُ﴾ a past verb with its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is conjoined to the clause «قال..». ﴿فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ﴾ a past verb and its object. ﴿الرَّجْفَةُ﴾ its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَأَصْبَحُوا﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb and its noun. ﴿فِي دارِهِمْ جاثِمِينَ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached (mutaʿalliq) to the khabar (predicate) «جاثمين»; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:38-38.t: ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿عاداً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb. ﴿وَثَمُودَ﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «عادا»; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿قَدْ تَبَيَّنَ﴾ «قد» is a particle of realization (taḥqīq), and a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿مِنْ مَساكِنِهِمْ﴾ also attached to the verb; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَزَيَّنَ﴾ conjoined to «تبين». ﴿لَهُمُ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿الشَّيْطانُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿أَعْمالَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَصَدَّهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَنِ السَّبِيلِ﴾ attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَكانُوا مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and «كان», its noun and its khabar (predicate); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:39-39.t: ﴿وَقارُونَ﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «عادا». ﴿وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهامانَ﴾ both conjoined to «قارون». ﴿وَلَقَدْ جاءَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a particle of oath and of the genitive, the lām occurs in the answer to the oath, «قد» is a particle of realization (taḥqīq), and a past verb and its object. ﴿مُوسى﴾ a delayed fāʿil (agent); the clause is the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿بِالْبَيِّناتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿ما﴾ negative. ﴿كانُوا سابِقِينَ﴾ «كان», its noun and its khabar (predicate); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:40-40.t: ﴿فَكُلًّا﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle; ﴿كلا أخذنا﴾ «كلا» is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿بِذَنْبِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَمِنْهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle; ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun, a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَرْسَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿حاصِباً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَمِنْهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to an omitted, fronted khabar. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a delayed mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَخَذَتْهُ﴾ a past verb and its object. ﴿الصَّيْحَةُ﴾ a delayed fāʿil; the clause is a ṣila. ﴿وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿خَسَفْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِهِ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿الْأَرْضَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a ṣila. ﴿وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَغْرَقْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a ṣila. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿ما﴾ negative. ﴿كانَ اللَّهُ﴾ «كان» and its noun. ﴿لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied «أن» after the lām; the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from «أن» and what follows it is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of «كان»; the verbal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لكِنْ﴾ a particle of rectification (istidrāk). ﴿كانُوا﴾ «كان» and its noun. ﴿أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾ a fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَظْلِمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar of «كانوا». The clause «كانوا..» is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:41-41.t: ﴿مَثَلُ الَّذِينَ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject), annexed to the relative noun. ﴿اتَّخَذُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb, and the Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَوْلِياءَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿كَمَثَلِ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «مثل»; the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿الْعَنْكَبُوتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿اتَّخَذَتْ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿بَيْتاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَإِنَّ أَوْهَنَ الْبُيُوتِ﴾ «إن» and its noun, annexed to «البيوت». ﴿لَبَيْتُ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿بيت العنكبوت﴾ the khabar of «إن», annexed to «العنكبوت»; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿لَوْ﴾ a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿كانُوا﴾ «كان» and its noun. ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar of «كانوا», and the clause «كانوا..» is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:42-42.t: ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ «إن» and its noun. ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يَدْعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is a ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنْ شَيْءٍ﴾ attached to what [the preposition and genitive noun] before them are attached to. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿هُوَ﴾ and a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ﴾ two khabars; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:43-43.t: ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿تِلْكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْأَمْثالُ﴾ badal (substitute). ﴿نَضْرِبُها﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿ما﴾ negative. ﴿يَعْقِلُها﴾ an imperfect verb and its object. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿الْعالِمُونَ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:44-44.t: ﴿خَلَقَ اللَّهُ السَّماواتِ﴾ a past verb with its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «السموات». ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾ the fronted khabar (predicate) of «إن». ﴿لَآيَةً﴾ the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿آية﴾ the noun of «إن». ﴿لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ naʿt (adjective) of «آية»; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:45-45.t:
﴿اتْلُ﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أُوحِيَ﴾ a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; the clause is a ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنَ الْكِتابِ﴾ also attached to the verb. ﴿وَأَقِمِ الصَّلاةَ﴾ conjoined to «اتل..». ﴿إِنَّ الصَّلاةَ﴾ «إن» and its noun. ﴿تَنْهى﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīl). ﴿عَنِ الْفَحْشاءِ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿وَالْمُنْكَرِ﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «الفحشاء». ﴿وَلَذِكْرُ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ), and «ذكر» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), annexed. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَكْبَرُ﴾ khabar; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and the Divine Name is mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the verbal clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿تَصْنَعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is a ṣila.
[Part Three]
[Continuation of Surat al-ʿAnkabūt]

daas-irab:46-46.t: ﴿وَلا تُجادِلُوا﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive «لا», the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَهْلَ الْكِتابِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), annexed to «الكتاب». ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿بِالَّتِي﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿هِيَ أَحْسَنُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is a ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ excepted by «إلا». ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a ṣila. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَقُولُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿آمَنَّا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بِالَّذِي﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿أُنْزِلَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb «[Translator's note: so in the source; «أُنْزِلَ» is a past verb.]», and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is a ṣila. ﴿إِلَيْنا﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿وَأُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ﴾ conjoined to «أنزل إلينا». ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿إِلهُنا﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَإِلهُكُمْ﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «إلهنا». ﴿واحِدٌ﴾ the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَنَحْنُ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿لَهُ﴾ attached to the khabar ﴿مُسْلِمُونَ﴾; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:47-47.t: ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿أَنْزَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَالَّذِينَ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and the relative noun is a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿آتَيْناهُمُ﴾ a past verb with its fāʿil and its first object. ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a ṣila (relative clause). ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «الذين». ﴿بِهِ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿مِنْ هؤُلاءِ﴾ a fronted khabar. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a delayed mubtadaʾ «[Translator's note: the Quranic word is «مَنْ»; the source prints it as «مِنْ».]»; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يُؤْمِنُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿بِهِ﴾ attached to the verb; the clause is a ṣila. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿ما يَجْحَدُ﴾ negative, and an imperfect verb, nominative. ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿الْكافِرُونَ﴾ fāʿil; the verbal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:48-48.t: ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿ما﴾ negative. ﴿كُنْتَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb and its noun. ﴿تَتْلُوا﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿كِتابٍ﴾ genitive in form, accusative in position as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «كنت», and the clause «ما كنت...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿تَخُطُّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿بِيَمِينِكَ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿إِذاً﴾ a particle of answer and requital (jawāb wa-jazāʾ). ﴿لَارْتابَ الْمُبْطِلُونَ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer to an omitted oath, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the answer to an implied oath, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:49-49.t: ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿هُوَ آياتٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿بَيِّناتٌ﴾ naʿt (adjective) of «آيات». ﴿فِي صُدُورِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to what precedes them. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ the relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أُوتُوا﴾ a passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿الْعِلْمَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين». ﴿وَما يَجْحَدُ بِآياتِنا إِلَّا الظَّالِمُونَ﴾: see ayah 47.

daas-irab:50-50.t: ﴿وَقالُوا﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَوْلا﴾ a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). ﴿أُنْزِلَ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿آياتٌ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّهِ﴾ attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «آيات»; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿إِنَّمَا﴾ the restraining and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿الْآياتُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَإِنَّما﴾ the restraining and the restrained. ﴿أَنَا نَذِيرٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its khabar. ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾ naʿt of «نذير»; the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it, so it is, like it, in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying. The clause «قل..» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:51-51.t: ﴿أَوَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation, and the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿لَمْ يَكْفِهِمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لم», the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَنَّا﴾ a particle resembling the verb, and its noun. ﴿أَنْزَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of «أنّا», and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from «أنّ», its noun and its khabar is the fāʿil of «يكفي»; the clause «لم يكفهم..» is resumptive. ﴿يُتْلى﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ attached to the verb; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾ the fronted khabar of «إن». ﴿لَرَحْمَةً﴾ the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ), and the delayed noun of «إن»; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَذِكْرى﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «رحمة». ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ attached to «رحمة». ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of «قوم».

daas-irab:52-52.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَفى﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; ﴿الله﴾ the Divine Name, a noun genitive in form and nominative in position as the fāʿil of «كفى». The clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بَيْنِي﴾ an adverb of place. ﴿وَبَيْنَكُمْ﴾ maʿṭūf (conjoined) to it. ﴿شَهِيداً﴾ tamyīz (specification). ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to «السموات»; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject), and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِالْباطِلِ﴾ attached to the verb; the clause is a ṣila. ﴿وَكَفَرُوا﴾ conjoined to «آمنوا». ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, genitive by the bāʾ; [the two] are attached to the verb. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُمُ﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الْخاسِرُونَ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of «أولئك»; the nominal clause is the khabar of «الذين», and the clause «الذين...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:53-53.t: ﴿وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and an imperfect verb with its fāʿil (agent) and its object. ﴿بِالْعَذابِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿لَوْلا﴾ a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿أَجَلٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مُسَمًّى﴾ naʿt (adjective), and the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ is omitted; the nominal clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿لَجاءَهُمُ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer to «لولا», and a past verb and its object. ﴿الْعَذابُ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is the answer to «لولا», with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلَيَأْتِيَنَّهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the lām prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam) «[Translator's note: so in the source; it then calls the clause the answer to an omitted oath, i.e. the lām is the one occurring in the answer.]», and an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿بَغْتَةً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is the answer to an omitted oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial. ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿لا يَشْعُرُونَ﴾ negative, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar of «هم», and the nominal clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:54-54.t: ﴿يَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِالْعَذابِ﴾ its i'rab has been given before. ﴿وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «إن» and its noun; and the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿لَمُحِيطَةٌ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿بِالْكافِرِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to «محيطة».

daas-irab:55-55.t: ﴿يَوْمَ يَغْشاهُمُ﴾ «يوم» is an adverb of time, and an imperfect verb and its object. ﴿الْعَذابُ﴾ its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿وَمِنْ تَحْتِ﴾ both conjoined to what precedes them. ﴿أَرْجُلِهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَيَقُولُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿ذُوقُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil. ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ «كان» and its noun; the clause is a ṣila (relative clause). ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «كنتم».
